research_artifacts.title: Social Health Insurance Act, 2023
research_artifacts.content_summary: Establishes the Social Health Authority (SHA), replacing NHIF. Mandates registration, biometric validation, and defines the three funds: PHC Fund, SHI Fund, and ECC Fund.

research_artifacts.title: Digital Health Act, 2023
research_artifacts.content_summary: Establishes the framework for e-health, data interoperability, and the Integrated Health Information System (IHIS). Mandates integration with IPRS.

research_artifacts.title: Data Protection Act, 2019
research_artifacts.content_summary: Regulates the processing of personal data. Classifies health data as 'Sensitive Personal Data' requiring specific safeguards and consent.

research_artifacts.title: PPB Guidelines on Good Distribution Practices
research_artifacts.content_summary: Standards for the supply chain of pharmaceuticals, including batch tracking to prevent counterfeits.

sections.title: 1. Admission & SHA Verification (IPRS Integration)
sections.description: Mandatory patient identification and benefit eligibility check via SHA/IPRS integration points.

sections.title: 2. Clinical Data & DHIS2 Reporting
sections.description: Capture of clinical data mapped to Ministry of Health (MOH) indicators for automated DHIS2 uplifts.

sections.title: 3. Pharmacy Track & Trace
sections.description: Inventory management controls to prevent counterfeit medication and ensure expiry compliance.

sections.title: 4. Billing & Claims (Tiered)
sections.description: Financial processing based on gazetted SHA benefit packages.

governance_rules.description: All health data transmission to the Digital Health Superhighway must be encrypted according to Data Protection Act 2019 standards.
Biometric verification is mandatory for claim submission to the Social Health Authority to prevent fraud.
Inventory disposal of expired medication must be logged and reported to the Pharmacy and Poisons Board.

SHA_ACT_2023_S26.content: Every person resident in Kenya shall be registered as a member of the Social Health Authority... using the Integrated Population Registration System as the primary source of data.
SHA_ACT_2023_S26.analysis: This creates a hard dependency on IPRS data. The application must validate the National ID against IPRS before creating a local patient record.

SHA_ACT_2023_S25.content: Establishes (a) Primary Health Care Fund, (b) Social Health Insurance Fund, (c) Emergency, Chronic and Critical Illness Fund.
SHA_ACT_2023_S25.analysis: Billing logic must segregate claims into these three buckets based on the diagnosis and facility level (Level 2/3 for PHC, Level 4/5 for SHIF/ECC).

SHA_ACT_2023_REG.content: Claims for specialised procedures or extended inpatient care require pre-authorization from the Authority.
SHA_ACT_2023_REG.analysis: Pre-auth workflow must be integrated for high-cost procedures.

DHA_2023_S18.content: The System shall facilitate the collection... of health data... and ensure interoperability with the Integrated Population Registration System.
DHA_2023_S18.analysis: Mandates the technical integration of the hospital system with the government's central identity database.

DHA_2023_S45.content: All health information systems shall use ICD-11 for diagnosis coding and submit aggregate data to DHIS2.
DHA_2023_S45.analysis: Requires ICD-11 integration and MOH 705/DHIS2 reporting compliance.

DPA_2019_S25.content: Data controllers shall ensure that personal data is... processed lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner... [and] collected for explicit, specified and legitimate purposes.
DPA_2019_S25.analysis: Requires explicit checkbox consent from the patient before capturing biometrics or sharing data with SHA/MOH.

PPB_GUIDELINES.content: Distributors must ensure a robust system to identify and prevent the entry of falsified medicines... including batch traceability.
PPB_GUIDELINES.analysis: Basis for the 'Track and Trace' module requirements (Batch #, Expiry, Serialization).

KMPDC_STD.content: Every medical practitioner must hold a valid license from the Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council.
KMPDC_STD.analysis: Claim validation requires verification of practitioner KMPDC license number.
